description: Look up a birthplace or event place in Moon Dasha's place data and get its place_id, coordinates and IANA time zone. Every Moon Dasha calculation that needs a place takes it as this place_id. Up to five matches, best first.

query.description: The place name, optionally followed by its state or country: "Jaipur", "Springfield Illinois", "Paris France".

name: find_place

place_id.description: Pass this to Moon Dasha calculation tools as place_id.

title: Find a place
